merger_description:
Centuria Property Funds No. 2 Limited (**CPF2L**) as the responsible entity of Centuria Sydney CBD Prime Office Fund proposes to acquire a 50% indirect interest in 680 George Street and 50 Goulburn Street, Sydney, New South Wales. The Acquisition will occur through Centuria Investment Management (CSPOF) Pty Ltd as trustee of the CSPOF Mid Trust (**Mid Trust**) acquiring 50% of the units in Latitude Landowning Trust (**Latitude Trust**), and through Centuria Investment Management (CSPOF) Pty Ltd in its personal capacity (**Mid Trustee**) acquiring 50% of the shares in Latitude Landowner Pty Ltd (**Latitude Trustee**).

The Mid Trust and Mid Trustee are wholly owned subsidiaries of CPF2L.

CPF2L is a wholly owned subsidiary of Centuria Capital Limited (**Centuria**). Centuria is an Australian-based investment manager that predominantly focuses on listed and unlisted property funds. Its core business is the provision of real estate investment management services, which involves establishing and managing listed and unlisted property funds that pool capital from retail, wholesale and institutional investors to acquire income-producing assets, predominantly commercial properties.

The Latitude Trust is currently 50% owned by 680G 50G Investments Pty Ltd as trustee of the 680G 50G Investment Trust, and the Latitude Trustee is 50% owned by Brookfield Capital Management Limited (members of the Brookfield Group (**Brookfield**)). The remaining 50% of the units in the Latitude Trust will continue to be held by AWPF Management No. 2 Pty Ltd as trustee for the Latitude Landholding Trust No. 2.

Brookfield comprises:

* Brookfield Corporation, a leading global investment firm focused on building long-term wealth for institutions and individuals around the world. Brookfield Corporation has three core businesses: Alternative Asset Management, Wealth Solutions, and its Operating Businesses, which are in renewable power, infrastructure, business and industrial services, and real estate;
* Brookfield Asset Management Ltd., a leading global alternative asset manager with over $1 trillion of assets under management across renewable power & transition, infrastructure, private equity, real estate, and credit.

Brookfield has various business activities and interests in Australia and invests across core infrastructure, renewable power and transition, real estate, and private equity.

determination_table_content.details:
Centuria Property Funds No. 2 Limited (CPF2L), as the responsible
entity of Centuria Sydney CBD Prime Office Fund, applied for a
notification waiver in respect of its proposed acquisition of a 50%
indirect interest in 680 George Street and 50 Goulburn Street, Sydney,
as described in the transaction documents provided as part of the
application (the Acquisition).
The Acquisition will occur through Centuria Investment Management
(CSPOF) Pty Ltd as trustee of the CSPOF Mid Trust (Mid Trust)
acquiring 50% of the units in Latitude Landowning Trust (Latitude
Trust), and through Centuria Investment Management (CSPOF) Pty
Ltd in its personal capacity (Mid Trustee) acquiring 50% of the
shares in Latitude Landowner Pty Ltd (Latitude Trustee).

The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission has
determined under section 51ABV(1)(a) of the Competition and
Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.

The acquirer, CPF2L, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Centuria Capital
Limited (Centuria). Centuria is an Australian-based investment
manager that predominantly focuses on listed and unlisted property
funds. Its core business is the provision of real estate investment
management services, which involves establishing and managing
listed and unlisted property funds that pool capital from retail,
wholesale, and institutional investors to acquire income-producing
assets, predominantly commercial properties.
Mid Trust and Mid Trustee are wholly owned subsidiaries of CPF2L.
The targets, Latitude Trust and Latitude Trustee, are respectively
50% owned by 680G 50G Investments Pty Ltd as trustee of the 680G
50G Investment Trust and 50% owned by Brookfield Capital
Management Limited, which are both members of the Brookfield
Group (Brookfield). The remaining 50% of the units in the Latitude
Trust will continue to be held by AWPF Management No. 2 Pty Ltd as
trustee for the Latitude Landholding Trust No. 2.
The two Brookfield entities own an interest in certain commercial
buildings in and around Sydney CBD, including 680 George Street
and 50 Goulburn Street.
Centuria and Brookfield both supply commercial real estate
investment management services.

In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver application, and
had regard to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition
and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information currently before it, the ACCC considers that
the Acquisition is unlikely to give rise to any material lessening of
competition. In particular:
a. Centuria’s existing share of commercial real estate
investment management services in and around the
Sydney CBD by floor space is estimated to be low and
the increment arising from the Acquisition would be
small
b. there are alternative providers of commercial real
estate investment management services with interests
in commercial properties and office buildings in and
around the Sydney CBD.
In these circumstances, the ACCC does not consider it necessary to
reach a concluded view on the likelihood of the notification
thresholds being met.
Given that material competition concerns are unlikely to arise, the
ACCC has determined that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.
The ACCC considers that the determination is consistent with the
object of the Act and the interests of consumers in promoting
competition.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notification waiver applications and to assessing competition
effects more generally, see the ACCC’s interim guidance on
notification waivers and merger assessment guidelines.
